o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *yaŕ- (“to write”). Cognate with Turkish yazmak, Turkmen ýazmak, Crimean Tatar yazmaq, Chuvash ҫыр (śyr) etc.

glosses: short sheepskin coat, waistcoat, sheepskin jacket

o.text: From gödək + -cə. Likely a calque of Russian куртка (kurtka).
From qara (“black”) + -şın, which is otherwise only attested in sarışın and in the borrowed name Aqşın.
